rules: Never deploy. Never switch branches. Never force-push.
One monolith (ComebackCityThreeKartRace.jsx) owner per wave — file ownership is disjoint within a wave.
Each wave: implement -> build+capture -> 3 harsh critics (rubric / blind A/B / artefact hunt) -> fix, up to 3 rounds.
test:bundle:kart measures the EXISTING dist-kart — always build:kart first or the number is stale.
Machine load fakes proof-test reds above load1 ~7: greens count, reds need a retry at a quiet moment.
Checkpoint commits must stage OWNED paths explicitly, never git add -A.
If a package keeps failing, check it OWNS the files its fix requires before running another round.
finalGate: final 18-frame capture + blind A/B vs tmp/aaa-visual/baseline
lessons: SCOPE LEAK: critics report every fault they see, including ones owned by a LATER wave (camera=wave6, shadows=wave4, materials=wave2). Wave-1 fix agents fed those findings tried to fix them inside the monolith they happened to own, and regressed camera + frameIntegrity by 2.0 each. FIX for waves 2-6: critics must tag each finding in-scope/out-of-scope for the current wave, and fix agents must defer out-of-scope findings to the owning wave instead of attempting them.

NO ROLLBACK POINT: rounds are not committed, so a round that regresses cannot be rolled back to the previous round. FIX for waves 2-6: commit a checkpoint after every capture round so the best round can be recovered.
